description: An HTML file that includes React and ReactDOM scripts and defines a React component (MyButton) within an inline script, used for rendering a React-based UI element.

classes.name: MyButton
classes.description: A React component class that renders a button with hover and click behaviors, managing internal hover state and allowing external control via props.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the button element, with event handlers for click and mouse enter, and dynamic button label based on hover state.
